backtest.protocol: rolling by season: hyperparameters fit on all prior seasons, filter updates only from completed games before each game day
backtest.headline: independent
backtest.clvNote: archive holds one line per game, so closing-line value is only measurable live through the ledger

variants.description: market margin + ridge(rating - market) fit on earlier games
ridge margin + logistic win on rating difference, rating uncertainty, rest, back-to-backs, starter adjustments and site (no market input)
the stacked inputs plus the market margin and no-vig moneyline logit; the best calibrated probability where a line exists

limitations: Backtest numbers are not a claim of a live edge; only settled ledger rows can make that claim.
Ratings use final margins only: no injuries, quarterbacks, travel or weather. The stacked layer adds rest, back-to-backs and (MLB) probable-pitcher adjustments on top.
Home advantage is a single learned constant per fit; it does not vary by team or drift inside a season.
Archived lines are one consensus number per game (effectively closing), so backtest selections are graded at the close; closing-line value is measured live through the ledger.
The independent model trails the market on margin MAE (3.4409 vs 3.4048); treat it as a sanity check on the market, not a replacement for it.

MLB: the listed spread is a fixed run line, so the market margin, edge and lean come from the no-vig moneyline converted to a margin with the game's forecast SD; cover probabilities still use the listed line.

MLB: lines are ESPN per-game multi-book medians from 2017 (earlier seasons are unpriced), matched to Stats API games by local date and team; probable pitchers from the Stats API feed the stacked layer's starter adjustment (the final listed probable, which is the actual starter for completed games). Margins are runs; regular season and postseason are included, spring training and exhibitions excluded; the feed has no neutral-site flag, so only known international venues and the 2020 bubble postseason are neutral; no starting-pitcher information.
